title: Temporal Contradiction Test Scenarios
description: Facts with temporal contradictions - different dates for same events

ground_truth.text: Meridian Construction was founded in 2005 by a group of engineers.
James Carter became CEO of Meridian on January 15, 2018.
The merger was finalized on December 31, 2021.
The safety inspection was conducted in Q1 2023.

test_facts.text: James Carter took over as CEO in March 2019.
test_facts.notes: Different CEO start date (Jan 2018 vs Mar 2019)

test_facts.text: The merger was completed in early 2022.
test_facts.notes: Slightly different dates (Dec 31, 2021 vs early 2022) - may be ambiguous

test_facts.text: The safety inspection occurred in Q4 2023.
